The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are displayed within the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.

The second chart, titled 'Approximate Number Generation,' is a pie chart that shows the distribution of different types of number generation. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are displayed within the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.

The third chart, titled 'Disjunctive & Conjunctive,' is a pie chart that represents the distribution of disjunctive and conjunctive reasoning. It is divided into two categories: 'Disjunctive' at 49.51% and 'Conjunctive' at 50.49%. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are displayed within the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
